how: Facts checked by hand or by agents on each county's own website and on state sites. Each item: v (yes, partly, no), a plain note, and the link that proves it. Built by pipeline/transparency.js from checks folders; these win over anything derived in server/lib/transparency.js.

TX.note: Texas’s state government doesn’t collect county budgets or spending reports in one place; each county posts its own. The Comptroller links to them.

KY.note: The Kentucky Auditor of Public Accounts posts every fiscal court’s audit, which includes its final budget and what it spent.
